name: German office intent blind holdout v2
description: 270 synthetic German questions, 30 per intent, written in one pass by four independent agents (southern German and phone typing; northern and western German and dictation; workplace variety and German as a second language; less common phrasings for three intents) that knew only the intent definitions: not the code, prompts, training data, other holdouts or any errors. Sentences with 0.8 or more similarity to the training data or other holdouts, and near duplicates within the set, were removed before selection. Used only to accept or reject trained adapters. No real persons, companies or customer data.
